movelist.name: Psychic
movelist.effect: The target is Pushed 1 meter in any direction. Psychic lowers the target’s Special Defense 1 Combat Stage on 17+.

movelist.name: Calm Mind
movelist.effect: Raise the user’s Special Attack 1 Combat Stage and raise the user’s Special Defense 1 Combat Stage.

movelist.name: Heal Pulse
movelist.effect: Restores 50% of the target’s max Hit Points. Heal Pulse’s user may not target itself with Heal Pulse.

movelist.name: Aromatherapy
movelist.effect: All allies in the burst are cured of one status condition of their choice.

abilities.name: Cruelty
abilities.trigger: The user hits a foe with a damaging attack
abilities.effect: After Damage is Resolved, the foe gains an Injury. The user is then informed of the total number of Injuries currently on the target, and may use that number to “purchase” the effects listed below. »» 1 Injury: The target loses 2 Hit Points. May be “pur- chased” multiple times. »» 1 Injury: The target is Slowed. »» 2 Injuries: Until the end of the encounter, the target may not gain Hit Points or Temporary Hit Points from any source. This effect ends if the target is switched out or Takes a Breather.

abilities.name: Prime Fury
abilities.effect: The user becomes Enraged, and gains +1 Combat Stage in each of Attack and Special Attack.

abilities.name: Magic Bounce
abilities.trigger: The user is hit by a Status Move
abilities.effect: The user may reflect the Move back to the attacker. This Ability may be used to change the placement and affiliation of any Hazards being set within 10 meters of the user as well. Defensive.
